name: Commercial Image-to-Video Model Benchmark via Magic Hour
description: A reproducible benchmark of 60 controlled image-to-video generation attempts across Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Sora 2, and LTX 2.5 through one Magic Hour API integration. The study includes four original commercial scenarios, three attempts per scenario-model pair, exact prompts, source images, 58 completed MP4 outputs, two preserved failures, timestamps, measured API credits, output checksums, machine-readable results, and reproduction code. Magic Hour AI, Inc. designed, funded, and published the study and provides the API used for every evaluated model. Completion status is not an aesthetic score; the release does not declare a quality winner. Licensing is file-specific: CC BY 4.0 for methodology, prompts, and result metadata; MIT for code; and the terms in MEDIA-LICENSE.md for generated media.
